title: Tulip Mania: The Flower Worth 17 Years of Wages 🌷

scenes.say: This flower once cost more than a craftsman earned in seventeen years.
February, sixteen thirty-seven. One tulip bulb sold for five thousand two hundred guilders.
Dutch traders bought bulbs they had never seen, in taverns, on promises.
Then one day in Haarlem, nobody bid. Within days, the market was gone.
The twist? The story of a ruined nation is mostly a legend, written two hundred years later.
Would you have sold your bulb, or held it?
